review_description: They made the whole experience as easy as possible for us, and they were quick, friendly, and informative about all aspects of getting solar power installed. We are very happy.
Yes the State Gov has created a great amount of uncertainty in my mind and I wonder when this will be resolved.The installer was helpful in my installation process.

I am not sure of the quality yet.   I was rather confused by all the companies claiming to all have the best most efficient solar panels etc.   I could not find information which compared installers, panels, inverters, or anywhere where there was feedback.   My system is due to be installed this Saturday.   I wish all the information you are gathering now was available when I was doing my research!
